back_translation: Sing for joy, O barren woman who has no children; break out in shouting, cry out with gladness, you who have never travailed in birth — for the children of the desolate woman are more than the children of the woman who has a husband, says the LORD.
Enlarge the site of your tent; stretch out the curtains of your dwelling — do not hold back. Lengthen your ropes and drive your tent stakes firm.
For you will spread out to both the right and the left; your offspring will possess the nations, and they will settle in the desolate cities.
Do not fear, for you will not be ashamed; do not be daunted, for you will not be disgraced. For you will forget the shame of your youth, and the reproach of your widowhood you will remember no more.
For your Maker is your husband — His name is the LORD of Hosts — and your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel; He will be called the God of all the earth.
For the LORD has called you back like a wife abandoned and bruised in spirit, like a wife of one's youth when she is rejected, says your God.
For a brief moment I abandoned you, but with great compassion I will gather you back.
In a flood of anger I hid my face from you for a moment, but with everlasting steadfast love I will have compassion on you, says the LORD your Redeemer.

To me this is like the waters in the days of Noah: as I swore that the waters of Noah would never flood the earth again, so I have sworn that I will not be angry with you and will not rebuke you again.
For though the mountains be removed and the hills be shaken, my steadfast love will not depart from you, and my covenant of peace will not be shaken, says the LORD who has compassion on you.
O afflicted city, storm-tossed and not comforted — behold, I will set your stones in antimony and lay your foundations with sapphires.
I will make your battlement peaks of rubies, your city gates of fiery sparkling jewels, and your whole encircling wall of precious stones.
And all your children will be disciples taught by the LORD, and the peace of your children will be very great.
You will be established in righteousness; you will be far from oppression, for you will not fear, and far from terror, for it will not come near you.
Behold, if anyone attacks you, it is not from me; whoever attacks you will fall before you.
Behold, I myself created the smith who blows the coals in the fire and forges a weapon fit for its work; and I myself created the destroyer to destroy.

No weapon formed against you will succeed, and every tongue that rises to accuse you in judgment you will prove wrong. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their vindication is from me, declares the LORD.
